messages.content: The airline moved our July 18 flight 35 minutes later. Please check the whole San Diego arrival plan against the hotel and transportation, and verify the names and hotel guest count. I don't want to revisit the flight or hotel choices.
I’ll review only the revised timing and confirmation details. What departure and arrival times are now shown in the airline notice?
ORD departure is now 9:40 a.m. and San Diego arrival is 11:58 a.m. The flight number and confirmation H7K3QP are unchanged.

That arrival still works. Allowing roughly 45 minutes to deplane and collect bags puts you outside the terminal around 12:45 p.m. The Glorietta Bay Inn’s standard check-in begins at 4:00 p.m., so there is no risk of arriving after its check-in window; you may simply be early. The hotel can hold luggage if the room is not ready.
What should I change for the rental pickup? We had noon in the notes, but the car itself still isn't booked.

Move the planned rental pickup to 1:00 p.m. That gives you enough time for baggage and the rental-car transfer without creating an unnecessarily late arrival in Coronado. The rental remains unbooked, so this is an itinerary adjustment rather than a reservation change.
Now check all three names and the hotel occupancy.

Flight confirmation H7K3QP lists Marcus Lee, Daniel Lee, and Owen Lee. Hotel confirmation GBI-847261 lists the same three guests: two adults and one child, age 12, in the Deluxe Room with Two Queen Beds for July 18-26.
Good. Give me the final arrival sequence and flag only anything that still needs action.

July 18 arrival plan: depart ORD at 9:40 a.m.; arrive SAN at 11:58 a.m.; allow until about 12:45 p.m. for deplaning and bags; target rental pickup at 1:00 p.m.; then drive to Glorietta Bay Inn. Standard check-in is 4:00 p.m., and the hotel can hold luggage if you arrive earlier. All traveler names and the hotel count of two adults plus one 12-year-old are correct. Only the rental car, checked bags, and seat assignments still need action; the flight and hotel remain confirmed and unchanged.
